pay_detail: Not a job. The program covers tuition and books for up to 14 credits a semester. Students pay student fees. They also get a bus pass and $7.50 a day for lunch.
name: Gateway to College
what_you_do: Students earn their high school diploma and college credits at the same time at the Madison Truax campus. The program gives support, advising and a college success class.
who_can_apply: Ages 16 to 20 who are behind in credits for their age, have a low GPA, and want to earn a diploma and start college classes. High school counselors refer students. Must commit 1 to 3 years and keep a C average.
deadline_text: No deadline is posted. Acceptance is competitive and based on space.
how_to_apply: Talk to your high school counselor, apply online with three writing prompts and your transcript, take the ACCUPLACER placement test, interview, then a committee decides within five business days. Contact 608-243-4597 or gatewaytocollege@madisoncollege.edu.
notes: The page says the program serves ages 16 to 21 in one place and 16 to 20 in the eligibility list. Check with the program.
